verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus's v2 API documents an endpoint to 'Start an automation for a specific contact', so a developer can programmatically trigger an automation for exactly one person from their product. However, nothing shows a true custom-event model, meaning named events with properties that automations listen for; it is a direct start-automation call. Missing for 10: custom named events with payload/properties, event-based automation triggers, depth of endpoint documentation, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fire a custom event from my product and have it trigger an automation for exactly that person
